The '''TX-1118 Series "Terminax" Assassin Droid''',<ref name="Arms & Equipment Guide">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''</ref> also known as the '''Terminax Model TX-1118 Assassin Droid'''<ref name="Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref> or '''Terminax TX series assassin droid''',<ref name="Arms & Equipment Guide" /> was a model of [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] manufactured by [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]] for use by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. Roughly humanoid in shape, the TX-1118 was designed with a variety of on-board weapons systems. It was originally marketed as a soldier, but was priced too high, and MerenData found themselves with a surplus of droids in their warehouses. In order to recover their development costs, MerenData reprogrammed the droids to eliminate the ethics programming and turn the TX-1118 into an assassin that would kill any being they were told to. This droid, known as the Terminax, was armed with a blaster rifle in one arm and a fragmentation grenade launcher in the other. The TX-1118 was known for its loyalty.
